column1: # AUDIO2: microphone noise suppression (EasyEffects RNNoise) and the automatic microphone choice. Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.

column9: ON = EasyEffects RNNoise sits between every microphone and every app (dictation keeps the raw microphone). Off lasts until the next login.
Forget a manual input choice: USB mic > Bluetooth headset > built-in mic.
Checks microphone -> EasyEffects (RNNoise) -> apps: unit, preset, rc keys, default source, source pin. Fix: ee-ctl restart or audio-ensure.
